verdict.rationale: Platform I/O headroom is a fair question for a desktop CPU, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers PCIe generation or lane counts, storage connectivity, or external I/O such as Thunderbolt or USB. The spec-page items cover only cache, clocks, ECC, vPro and AI frameworks, and the community items discuss memory speeds and performance, none of which addresses the I/O specs the story asks about.
